findings.claim: The arroyo commit callable is invoked from the background _commit_loop thread rather than the consumer/StreamProcessor thread, so KafkaConsumer's unlocked stage_offsets/commit state is accessed concurrently with the main loop and rebalance callbacks.

verifier.reason: In src/sentry/remote_subscriptions/consumers/result_consumer.py:249-259, create_thread_queue_parallel_worker wraps Arroyo's commit callable in commit_offsets and passes it as commit_function to SimpleQueueProcessingStrategy. SimpleQueueProcessingStrategy starts a background daemon thread running _commit_loop (src/sentry/remote_subscriptions/consumers/queue_consumer.py:270-291) that calls self.commit_function(committable) at line 287 rather than committing from poll() on the StreamProcessor thread, concurrently touching KafkaConsumer's unlocked stage_offsets/commit state with the main loop and rebalance callbacks.
